selection_requirement: One real contiguous neighbourhood boundary per selected study location
evidence: Versioned GeoPackage boundary and source query

selection_requirement: Acquire with an existing OpenUBEM input mode: address coordinate bounding box or OSM XML
evidence: Acquisition configuration and raw footprint manifest

selection_requirement: Rank candidate areas by residential buildings per km2 and dwelling or residential floor-area proxy
evidence: Candidate comparison table with pre-registered density rule

selection_requirement: Select a dense residential-dominant area rather than a dispersed citywide sample
evidence: Selection decision record and rejected-candidate reasons

selection_requirement: Reach at least 100 residential buildings for N1 after filtering (500-600 preferred not a gate); N2 may be any larger whole official unit (amended 2026-08-24 ruling D-EU-02-C)
evidence: Residential registry count and exclusion reconciliation

selection_requirement: Keep the natural/declared boundary; do not trim buildings merely to hit an exact count
evidence: Boundary checksum and deterministic spatial join

selection_requirement: Use identical boundary and building IDs in all four audit panels
Show non-residential and unknown-use footprints only as excluded context
evidence: Excluded-building manifest disjoint from layout IDF and simulation manifests

selection_requirement: Report construction period EPC/energy-record availability residential typology and construction material/set
evidence: Four-panel figure plus machine-readable category counts

selection_requirement: Use separate neighbourhood manifests when more than one site is selected
evidence: Unique neighbourhood_id and no cross-site aggregation before audit
